dz: 共同主政者斯蒂芬和君士坦丁被君士坦丁七世推翻并被强迫成为僧侣,君士坦丁七世成为了拜占庭帝国唯一的皇帝.
de: The co-emperors Stephen and Constantine are overthrown and forced to become monks by Constantine VII, who becomes sole emperor of the Byzantine Empire.

t: 拜占庭皇帝君士坦丁七世加冕他的儿子罗曼诺斯二世为同族.
te: Byzantine Emperor Constantine VII crowns his son Romanos II as co-emperor.
